documents.title: Customer incident description (written statement)
documents.text:
Statement of Farhan Ansari - claim for MH04GT0092

On 8th June 2026 morning around 7:40 I was going to office on the Western Express Highway towards Andheri. It was raining very heavily since night and the road was full of water. Near Jogeshwari a container truck in front of me braked all of a sudden - maybe because of a pothole or something crossing. I braked fully but the car slid on the wet road and went under the back side of the truck at around 35-40 speed.

The bonnet and front portion got crushed under the truck body and both airbags opened. I got a jerk and some pain in the chest from the seat belt but did not need admission, only check up. The truck driver stopped for a minute and then drove off. My car had to be towed from the spot to Ridhi Sidhi garage in Andheri East.

The garage says the front structure, radiator, AC, airbags, dashboard everything is gone and gave estimate of Rs 3,85,600. The car is a 2016 model. Please arrange survey and do the needful at the earliest.

Farhan Ansari
10/06/2026
